name: Dan Brunski
current_role: Co-founder and President, Citra (Citra Space Corporation, space domain awareness, Colorado Springs); co-founder and former CTO of True Anomaly
profile: Electrical engineer and former Air Force space operator who co-founded True Anomaly in 2022 with Even Rogers, Kyle Zakrzewski and Tom Nichols after they served together in the 4th Space Operations Squadron; he was its first CTO. In 2024 he and Nichols left to co-found Citra, a veteran-owned company building telescopes, antennas and software for space domain awareness, where he is President.
interesting_fact: True Anomaly's founding thesis took shape in 2018 when Brunski and Even Rogers were working on a national-security space effort and ran into the limits of DoD bureaucracy; Rogers calls him 'a brilliant tactician, a gifted scientist' with 'a refreshingly dark sense of humor.'
deep_cut_fact: His new company Citra builds its own engines, including 'keplime', a high-performance orbital-mechanics package, and 'pixelemon', a high-speed image-processing engine for space-object tracking.
notes: No longer at True Anomaly (left Aug 2024 per Contrary Research: https://research.contrary.com/report/true-anomaly); presumably retains founder equity. Reach via Citra rather than True Anomaly.

name: Ofer Smadari
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Torq (AI SOC / security hyperautomation platform; Americas HQ Denver, R&D in Israel)
profile: Ofer Smadari co-founded Torq in 2020 with Leonid Belkind (CTO) and Eldad Livni (Chief Innovation Officer) to build no-code security automation; it has since repositioned as an agentic 'AI SOC' platform. Torq raised a $140M Series D at a $1.2B valuation in January 2026 led by Merlin Ventures, acquired Jit in May 2026 and now has 430+ employees across the US, Canada, Israel and Europe.
interesting_fact: Smadari pitches Torq as moving security operations past legacy SOAR and SIEM tools; in 2026 Torq branded its builder 'the Cursor of Security Operations' and unveiled a learning 'SOC Brain'.

name: James Cadwallader
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Profound (AI search visibility / Answer Engine Optimization and AI marketing platform, New York)
profile: James Cadwallader co-founded Profound in 2024 with CTO Dylan Babbs to help brands understand and control how they appear in ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and other answer engines. Profound went from a $3.5M seed (Aug 2024) to a $20M Series A (Kleiner Perkins, 2025), a $96M Series C at $1B (Lightspeed, Feb 2026) and a $180M Series D at $1.8B led by Sequoia and Kleiner (Sep 2026).
interesting_fact: Profound coined/championed 'AEO' (Answer Engine Optimization); in its Series A post the founders predicted AI conversations would drive over 50% of online commerce (~$2.5T a year) by 2027. Customers include Target, Walmart, Figma and US Bank.
deep_cut_fact: Profound's seed was led by Keith Rabois at Khosla with angels incl. Scott Belsky and Balaji Srinivasan, and its Series A angels included David Senra of the Founders podcast, Jordi Hays of TBPN and Vercel's Guillermo Rauch. He met Dylan Babbs in the hallways of South Park Commons in New York.
notes: Valuation now $1.8B (Series D, Sep 2026), above Hurun's $1B. Media-friendly, frequent blog author. SPC meeting source: https://www.tryprofound.com/blog/a-second-home-in-san-francisco
